QuestInfo.name: Rain's Maple Quiz 3
QuestInfo.2: In the Equipment Inventory, I can check the items I'm wearing, and I can also double-click to unequip them.

0.0: My questions aren't that hard because I let you keep trying until you get them right. Nice of me, huh? Tell me when you're ready for the 3rd question.

1.0:
What window can you use to check the items you're wearing?

#L0# #bEquipment Inventory
#L1# Character Stat
#L2# Item Inventory#k#l
1.1: That's right! You can see what equipment your character is wearing in Equipment Inventory.

0.1: You can check your stats in Character Stat. Make sure to remember that!
0.2: In Item Inventory, you can see what items you have.
